insight.headline: Taxes Recalculated
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address of an unfulfilled order is updated. This change affects the GraphQL Admin API and will be implemented as of August 31, 2026. The recalculation is based on the new destination.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should review their code to ensure compatibility with the updated orderUpdate mutation. They should test their apps to verify that taxes are correctly recalculated when the shipping address is changed. The GraphQL Admin API will return an error if the mutation is not properly formatted. Developers can use the orderUpdate mutation to update the shipping address and recalculate taxes. They should also be aware that this change may affect the overall cost of the order and the customer's experience.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see accurate tax calculations when the shipping address of an order is updated. This change will help prevent errors in tax calculations and ensure compliance with tax regulations.
insight.why_it_matters: This change is important because it ensures that taxes are accurately calculated and applied to orders, which is critical for merchants to comply with tax regulations and avoid potential penalties. It also improves the customer experience by providing accurate order totals.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, allowing AI agents to interact with online stores. Agents can search catalogs, manage carts, and proceed to checkout on behalf of shoppers.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing developers to deploy Hydrogen storefronts from dev stores. Note that development stores don't include public environments.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, allowing for more accurate order tracking.

updates.title: Updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps
updates.summary: Updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps better reflect real-world fulfillment operations, making it easier to achieve Built for Shopify status.

updates.title: Hydrogen developer preview update: July 30, 2026
updates.summary: The Hydrogen developer preview update adds new capabilities, including Vue bindings, to build Shopify storefronts with the Hydrogen API.

updates.title: New fields for cash management activities and drawers in POS
updates.summary: New fields are available for cash management activities and drawers in POS, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities.
CLI version 4.6.0 removes deprecated draftable extension process and dev session support branching, and adds flags to avoid prompts in app config linking.

updates.title: Merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests
updates.summary: Merchants can now see partner details on collaborator requests, providing more context for decision-making.

updates.title: The shopify-account component for customer accounts is now a Theme Store requirement
updates.summary: The shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement, enabling customers to sign in and manage their accounts directly on the storefront.

updates.title: createdAt is now available on the Customer object in Shopify Functions
updates.summary: The createdAt field is now available on the Customer object in Shopify Functions, allowing for more accurate customer account creation date and time tracking.

updates.title: Updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes
updates.summary: Updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes, ensuring accurate tax calculations for unfulfilled orders.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.3
updates.summary: @shopify/cli-hydrogen version 13.0.3 includes patch changes, such as using the IPv4 loopback address in local debugger instructions.

recap.headline: Shopify updates Hydrogen, GraphQL Admin API, and more

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Hydrogen developer preview update adds new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and Oxygen is now available on development stores. The @shopify/cli-hydrogen and @shopify/mini-oxygen packages have been updated with patch changes.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Enhancements
themes.detail: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, and new fields are available for cash management activities and drawers in POS. Additionally, the Customer object in Shopify Functions now includes a createdAt field.

themes.title: Ecosystem Updates
themes.detail: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, and merchants can see partner details on collaborator requests. The shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement, and updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes.

Review and implement the updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps
